label: Non-passional love as willing some good to its object (q.20 aa.1-2)
definition: Loves g x: g loves x in the thin q.20 a.2 sense of a first act of will toward x, not a sensory passion. The one-way OPEN sufficient rule WillingGoodEntailsLove says that willing an actual good of x to x suffices. Excluded: friendship (q.20 a.2 ad 3 restricts benevolence properly speaking to rational creatures), affection or emotional change, equal degree of love, approval of wrongdoing, and the perfect relational love of the hiddenness challenge (DEF-HIDDENNESS-PERFECT-LOVE, 4b2943ad-3bc5-5492-94bc-f21e9f1a12ab), which seeks personal relationship with capable creatures.
note: Analyst interpretation, attribution deferred (docs/notes/divine-love-goodness-bridge.md). In Lean the relation is the primitive parameter Loves of TruthCore.Case.Catholicism.DivineLoveBridge; nothing defines it, and it is not an alias of WillsGoodFor. No argument passes from this sense to hiddenness PerfectLove or GodLoves; that projection is an OPEN bridge owned by issue 1735. A pinned witness for ST I q.20 aa.1-2 would source it.
